openings.claim: Coupling recorded-boundary digest comparisons to a provenance ledger may improve earliest-supported divergence reports; physical synergy or measured improvement is not claimed.
openings.delta: Change the interface: each comparison carries manifest stage order, record identifiers and missingness into ledger claims and unresolved intervals. Keep mismatches separate from explanations. Blank warnings and absent records imply neither successful execution nor nonexecution; timestamp inversion remains an anomaly, not reordered stages.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, independent digest results plus a ledger, intact coupling should reduce unsupported definite claims or narrow correctly bounded unresolved intervals. Mere additive benefit predicts equivalent reports after the link is broken. Accurate equality would defeat the coupling advantage; more narrow but incorrect intervals would also defeat it.
openings.probe: Cache supplied fields using at most twelve manual inspections per pair; log counts. Generate exploratory baseline stage-order review, A-alone digest comparison, B-alone evidence ledger, intact A×B, and link-broken reports. In the broken condition preserve both parent contents but remove comparison-to-claim boundary links. Use the two disjoint three-pair subsets to compare intact and broken variants within twenty additional minutes; freeze outputs before opening the two answer sheets, scoring only boundaries they actually cover. Apply the specified removal of one transform record in each of two pairs during final review. Score supported-stage correctness, interval coverage/width, citations, next-check feasibility, inspection counts, setup minutes and link-maintenance edits. These shared-input ablations do not establish independent performance effects.
assumptions: Use the supplied spreadsheet or script within sixty analyst minutes; stop before inspection or time limits, retaining unresolved intervals.
Every definite claim cites a supplied record; earliest means earliest supported boundary in manifest order, without assuming unrecorded execution.
For all six pairs, output stage or interval, record references, and a next check of supplied boundary fields or manifest entries, requiring no live access.
If maintenance exhausts capacity or broken links perform equally, retain independent parents; coupling usefulness remains uncertain.

assessment: One bounded workflow hypothesis and probe; deployment and informative superiority remain unestablished.
